desc: Run the oracle battery; tabulate OK/MISMATCH and resolve the four pinned cases (C5(1,3)=5, star center-leaf=6, lollipop(1,2)=8, tri+tail(4,5)=7); flag any non-path instance returning -1.
Pin down the exact A2 penalty rule for w ∈ {S,T} and whether a pocket at S with an available cycle avoids the penalty.

Based on brute-force results, derive and prove the final formula: (i) shortest cycle containing both S and T, (ii) 2d + 2·(min pocket detour) with endpoint penalties, (iii) cycle through exactly one of S,T plus 2·dist of the other; confirm impossibility iff graph is a path.

Design the O(N+M) algorithm for the validated formula: BFS from S and T; exact shortest cycle through S,T (vertex-disjoint path pair); shortest cycle through one vertex + distance of the other to it; pocket-detour computation via degrees/off-path neighbors.
Fuzz-compare the formula implementation against brute force on many random connected small graphs (all S,T pairs), plus exhaustive N ≤ 6.
Finalize Python solution with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer), adjacency lists, O(N+M) complexity for N,M ≤ 2e5, and verify on the three samples.
